reviews.title: TOO EXPENSIVE
reviews.text: This game is good in the racing aspect, however there are many problems with it. First you only get one engine, Thomas. And you have to pay $7 just to have more engines! And once you finish with Thomas and you don’t wanna pay for more engines, guess what you’re out of luck.  Also it is All engines Go themed. And I absolutely despise All engines go. Also, it’s out of date by now because of the new 2026 show. I recommend that once you finish with Thomas, you can unlock Percy. If you want them from the get-go, you can pay. But you get to unlock engines if you finish.
